description: simobility is a Python framework for prototyping vehicle-fleet service simulations. It provides vehicles, passenger bookings, demand and routing components, event logs and measures such as pickup rate, waiting time and empty distance. Inputs include fleet size, trip requests, routing and matching algorithms, and simulation steps; outputs are event histories and service metrics. The city or abstract grid and run duration are defined by the user. The package is free under MIT terms and can be installed from PyPI. Its examples include a grid world, simple ride service and taxi scenario. A limitation is that benchmark run times in the README depend on the chosen router and hardware; the OSRM router was slower than the built-in linear router in the stated tests. Results from a synthetic fleet are not observed transport performance. The framework supports comparison of dispatch and shared-mobility strategies. It can integrate with OSRM for routes, but no map data or simulation was run here.
name: simobility fleet-service simulation framework
